summary.note: distance_vs_gazebo_range_diff is a self-consistency coherence check (AimingManager's internally re-derived distance_m vs. the Gazebo ground-truth range_m fed in as laser_range_m), not an accuracy claim against reality -- the video's actual 3D target motion has no ground truth. iou_vs_gt is the only metric checked against independent (human-annotated) ground truth.
